Hi Sophie — great to meet you and thanks for reaching out!

I'm Marissa on the Commercial SDR team at Redwood. Happy to get a demo scheduled and loop in Michael (AE) so we can cover pricing/contracting. Quick questions so we make the session most useful:

- Do you have an internal target monthly spend or a budget range for Q4?
- Any compliance/regulatory requirements (SOC2, data residency) we should prepare for?

Here are a few 30-minute slots that work for Michael and me next week (PST):
- Tue 2026-09-01 09:00 - 09:30
- Tue 2026-09-01 10:30 - 11:00
- Wed 2026-09-02 11:00 - 11:30

Or you can pick a time on my calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/schedule/marissa/30min

I've attached a short pricing overview in case it's helpful before the call.

Agenda proposal (30m):
1) Quick intros + high-level goals (5m)
2) Demo: latency, batching/cost controls, private deployment options (15m)
3) Pricing model & next steps (10m)

If that works I'll go ahead and send a calendar invite.

Best,
